description: This file defines the UpdateUI class which provides static methods for determining weather icon identifiers based on weather conditions and time, as well as translating day names into localized strings within an Android weather application.

classes.name: UpdateUI
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for UI updates related to weather conditions and day translations.

methods.name: getIconID
methods.description: Returns a weather icon identifier string based on weather condition code and time parameters.

methods.name: TranslateDay
methods.description: Translates English day names into localized strings using Android resources.
